verdict.rationale: Versioning is documented: plugin manifests carry a version, marketplaces offer version tracking from git repositories, and the API accepts an optional skill `version` (which implies pinning). Skills are plain filesystem artifacts, so review and rollback depend on outside git workflows rather than any built-in feature. missing for 10: explicit rollback or version-pinning-to-revert documentation, a built-in review/diff/approval flow for skill changes, and independent hands-on corroboration of version management.
